authority: User-approved consolidation after the completed UCL internal-supervisor discussion
preserves_as_historical_evidence: all completed validation-only artifacts under their original contracts
cloud hardware, recovery, hash and sync gates

data_contract.test_opening_rule: A single official-test pass requires a later validation freeze, exact artifact audit and explicit user approval.
data_contract.selection_population: seen-aspect validation evidence within the exact outer training scope

architecture.primary: true two-stage aspect presence followed by aspect-conditioned sentiment
architecture.aspect_selection: uncapped multilabel thresholding with no forced top-k fallback
architecture.sentiment_decoder: always top-1 and optionally the runner-up above a separately selected seen-only threshold
architecture.one_stage_36_pair_role: matched architecture control and Level 1 conventional reference only

L1.name: Closed-taxonomy supervised reference
L1.required_method: word-plus-character TF-IDF with one-vs-rest logistic regression over 36 aspect-sentiment pairs
purpose: provide a conventional UCL thesis baseline
L1.thesis_role: short reference table, not a contribution

L2.name: Single-unseen LOAO main experiment
L2.evaluation_taxonomy: all twelve candidates on every validation review

representation_conditions.D: held-out canonical name plus frozen minimal description
representation_conditions.R: held-out globally selected positive-rich guidance; retained as a completed local controlled ablation only

representation_invariants: same checkpoint or frozen model across N D R
same deterministic few-shot demonstrations across N D R
same review and candidate identities across N D R
same aspect and runner-up sentiment thresholds across N D R
all seen candidates retain canonical name plus frozen minimal description

result_views.L2_S: supplied-candidate/oracle diagnostic derived from held-out raw scores and oracle-gated sentiment scores
result_views.L2_E: primary end-to-end full-taxonomy prediction over seen and unseen candidates

primary_description_contrasts: R minus D for the completed TF-IDF and E5 confirmation only
L2.thesis_role: core experiment and full model-family comparison

L3.name: Targeted dual-unseen robustness
L3.pair_selection_rule: six disjoint adjacent pairs over the frozen canonical order, chosen without outcome inspection so every aspect appears exactly once
L3.primary_condition: DD: both held-out aspects receive canonical name plus frozen minimal description
removed_from_core: full NN DN ND DD RR description crossover
requirement to run every model family
L3.purpose: multi-unseen robustness rather than primary description-effect estimation
L3.opaque_unknown_anomaly_arm: deferred until candidate identity, output identity and sentiment scoring are separately pre-registered

L4.name: Parent-group structured taxonomy shift
L4.primary_condition: D: all held-out group aspects receive canonical name plus frozen minimal description
L4.reporting_limit: show every group separately and do not claim strong cross-group inference from three folds

few_shot_contract.selection: deterministic stable order from the exact outer train fold
few_shot_contract.stage_1: two Y and two N demonstrations
few_shot_contract.stage_2: one negative, one neutral and one positive demonstration where support permits
few_shot_contract.sharing: same demonstrations across N D R within an outer scope

description_to_classifier_transfer.stage_2: reuse the registered aspect-conditioned capped-two sentiment component

rich_description_gate.development: 72 train-only pseudo-folds across strict TF-IDF and frozen E5 selected R2_positive_concat globally
rich_description_gate.confirmation: twelve Level 2 validation folds for each of strict TF-IDF and frozen E5, with Stage 2 fixed to D
rich_description_gate.decision: retain one local R ablation and move interface exploration to the appendix; do not expand R to Frozen-Qwen few-shot, DistilBERT or QLoRA
rich_description_gate.reason: both confirmation methods lost presence AP, presence F1 and held-out pair F1 while increasing false-positive rows

reuse_policy.default: reject unless every scientific and artifact field is exact
required_exact_fields: threshold selection population, objective and tie-break
candidate_exact_reuse_subject_to_audit: selected old L3 DD rows for the six newly registered pairs
cloud checkpoint, resume, telemetry and replication infrastructure

execution_phases: P0 publish this revised plan and revoke the old 26-scope launch manifest
P1 build an exact reuse and missing-work matrix without opening official test
P2 complete the validation-only Level 1 logistic-regression reference
P3 implement, test and run the local Level 2 description-to-classifier weight-transfer experiment
P4 complete or exactly reuse local Level 2 TF-IDF, E5 and Frozen-Qwen zero-shot N D R evidence, then run the registered rich-interface gate
P5 regenerate and audit a reduced cloud manifest for Level 2 N D and Level 4 D only
P6 run Frozen-Qwen few-shot, DistilBERT and QLoRA N D validation with immutable local replication
P7 freeze Level 2 paired analysis and Level 4 group-wise analysis
P8 decide whether the optional six-pair Level 3 DD study adds enough information to execute or merely report already compatible validation evidence
P9 update thesis methods, results plan, limitations and supervisor materials
P10 run a new test-blind freeze audit; official test remains blocked pending explicit approval

cloud_replan.note: All counts must be regenerated from the final manifest because N D R result conditions change scoring payload counts even when they share a training scope.

global_stop_conditions: official-test access or any test contract
target labels or outcomes used for selection
missing, duplicate or overlapping scope ownership
checkpoint, score-shard, cache, manifest or hash conflict
third sentiment emitted for one aspect
active unneeded cloud resource or unbounded billing
